claim_summary: TimeClaw compares candidate time-series agent executions by task metrics, counters exploration collapse, and distills task-scoped experience for later inference-time reuse.

claim_evidence.quote: we present TimeClaw, an exploratory execution learning framework that turns exploratory execution into reusable hierarchical distilled experience through a four-stage loop: Explore, Compare, Distill, and Reinject.

modules.name: Metric-supervised exploratory execution learning
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 no: the explore-compare-distill loop takes the task loss L_tau and the validity set as inputs (Eq. 1) and applies unchanged to forecasting, reasoning and classification, so its state and control do not change with the task family. R3_2 no: no temporal operation. R3_3 yes: branch scheduling, comparison and experience update.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - metric is a parameter of a task-agnostic loop
R3_2_GTS:no - no temporal semantics in the loop
R4:Planning and Orchestration; Optimization and Evolution

evidence.quote: TimeClaw implements exploratory execution learning as a four-stage loop, Explore → Compare → Distill → Reinject, that turns exploration into reusable inference-time experience.

modules.name: Task-aware tool dropout
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 no: dropout depends on per-task tool-usage counts and a never_drop set, neither of which embeds an output requirement or validator. R3_2 no. R3_3 yes: tool exposure control during exploration.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - usage-count rule is task-indexed but task-agnostic
R4:Tools and Execution; Optimization and Evolution

evidence.quote: TimeClaw mitigates this problem with task-aware tool dropout, which operates during explorationtime sub-agent tool exposure.

modules.name: Hierarchical distilled experience and reinjection
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 no: the 9-tuple rule, confidence, conflict registration and injection flag are keyed by task id but do not encode any output requirement or verifier. R3_2 no: no timestamps or availability. R3_3 yes: memory state and prompt reinjection.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - task id only scopes the store
R4:Memory and Context; Optimization and Evolution
